data.gender_notes: Meir is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Meir means 'my light'. It is derived from the Hebrew word 'm'or', which means 'light'. Meir is a name of biblical origin and is mentioned in the Hebrew Bible, specifically in the book of Genesis, where it is the name of the grandson of Isaac and the father of Judah. The name Meir carries the meaning “My Light” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew. Parents who choose Meir usually hope their child will grow to embody my light and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_greek.name: Μεΐρ
in_greek.meaning: Μεΐρ σημαίνει αυτός που φωτίζει ή φωτιστής

Στην Καινή Διαθήκη δεν υπάρχει άμεση αναφορά στο όνομα Μεΐρ, αλλά η έννοια του φωτός είναι κεντρική στο χριστιανικό μήνυμα.
